  > - `protocols_real.parquet` (Fig 4, Tab 2) and `bound_coverage_real.parquet` (Fig 5): same columns as the synthetic files. `ci_kind = pool-bootstrap` (R = 40 resampled pools, interval placed on the point estimate, clipped to [0,1]; `n_boot_or_worlds` = 41 counts the pool itself), so label it differently from the synthetic `world-spread-t` and say the intervals are coarse. `coverage`/`overstate_prob` = anti-conservative score, `coverage_cons`/`overstate_cons` = conservative score (truth + 1.645 SE); `K_eff`, `sigma_theta` empty.
  > - Cells: random B in {20,100} x N_tot in {60,120,240}; hill-climb and successive halving at 120, 240. Truth = accuracy of the deployed configuration on pool items outside U (U is 16% of the pool at 240: small finite-population shift).
  > - Numbers (N_tot=120, random B=100): naive overstates in 91% of draws (bias +0.052), optimism bootstrap 62%, .632 66%, cross-fit 48%, splits 49-50%; max-t covers 97.0% (CI 93.3-99.4) over the declared set, 96.5% over the evaluated one; successive halving over its evaluated set covers only 81-89%, over the declared set 98%.

The main text now reports the real pool (N_tot = 120, random B = 100: naive exceeds the fresh accuracy in 91% of draws, optimism bootstrap 62%, .632 66%, cross-fit/splits ~50%; max-t over the declared set covers 97.0% with width 0.069, Bonferroni/Šidák 99.5% with width 0.092, held-out bounds 96–97% with widths 0.092/0.140, pointwise 69%; Fig 5: max-t over the evaluated set holds for random search, is inconclusive for hill-climb and fails for successive halving, 0.81–0.86, while the declared set covers 0.97–0.99 for every searcher). Please draw the real arm as the main series with the synthetic arm beside it (as panels or open markers), both scorings (anti-conservative and conservative, rule (b)) visible for coverage and overstatement, and the interval kind of each in the README line for the caption.
  > 2. **Tab 2** (protocol summary at N_tot = 120, random B = 100: protocol × estimand × P(report > fresh) / coverage × width × deployed-accuracy cost, with intervals), from `protocols_real`. Tab 2 sits in §6.4 beside Fig 4.
